```{r}
install.packages("fortunes")
library(fortunes)
library(tidyverse)
install.packages("gt")
library(gt)
```
```{r}
my_first_vector <- c(1, 5, 9)
print(my_first_vector)
```
```{r}
character_vec <- c("hello", "this", "is", "a", "character", "vector")
print(character_vec)
```
```{r}
logical_vec <- c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)
print(logical_vec)
```
```{r}

xyz_vec <- c(x, y, z)
```

```{r}

```
```{r}

x*5
x>5
```

```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)


print(my_data_frame)
```
or
```{r}
fruits <- c("apple", "pear", "banana")
lengths <- c(22, 30, 55)
weights <- c(150, 165, 170)

my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = fruits,
  length = lengths,
  weight = weights
)


print(my_data_frame)
```
better formatting
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
